sdfmm_seed42.name: FinancialAD final SD-FMM repair36 seed42 20261117
command:
set -euo pipefail
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 MKL_NUM_THREADS=4 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=4 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH="$PWD"
trap 'tail -n 80 "$CQ_OUTPUT_DIR/progress.log" >&2' ERR
bash scripts/run_repair_cq.sh smoke
python -m finad_repair.experiment --family sdfmm --seeds 42 --device cuda --data "$CQ_OUTPUT_DIR/inputs/tabular" --graphs "$CQ_OUTPUT_DIR/inputs/graphs" --output "$CQ_OUTPUT_DIR/results" >> "$CQ_OUTPUT_DIR/progress.log" 2>&1
python -c 'import os,shutil;shutil.rmtree(os.path.join(os.environ["CQ_OUTPUT_DIR"],"pip-cache"),ignore_errors=True)'
